generation: On a fresh disposable directory, v3.4.0 saved a synthetic observation, v3.7.2 opened the store with stats, then v3.4.0 opened it again with stats. The last open changed both FTS tokenizer definitions back to plain trigram. The observation ID, project and title survived. sqlite_schema was exported by object name with Kind, Table and SQL for all objects. The checked-in fixture uses sorted keys, UTF-8 and LF. No catalogue DDL was manually edited.
controls: Official v3.7.2 admitted an untouched copy taken before the final open and rejected the final catalog.
